items.title: Satellite Images Show Manhattan-Sized Ice Island Breaking Away From Greenland Glacier
items.summary: New satellite images show an ice island about the size of Manhattan breaking away from a Greenland glacier, marking the largest loss of floating ice there in over 10 years. [Read More]

items.title: Bobcat Viciously Attacks World’s Largest Rattlesnake in Dramatic Camera Trap Photos
items.summary: A remote camera has captured dramatic images of a bobcat viciously attacking the world's largest rattlesnake species in Florida -- a type of encounter that is rarely documented in the wild. [Read More…

items.title: Miller Tripods is Closing Down After Nearly 80 Years of Business
items.summary: Miller Tripods, the company that invented the fluid head for motion picture cameras back in 1946, has announced that it is closing down. [Read More]
